title: Lucinda T FDE 3536 NDE 3536
content: I had to run into the sea to rescue my (profoundly deaf) daughter. To summarize, I was repeatedly knocked under the waves, and twice carried along, arms pinioned, rotating slightly, in the undercurrent. I prayed, 'Help me Jesus', and felt the concomitant calm. During the longer of the two periods, I naturally assumed I was surely to die. At this stage I saw five amazingly spiritually beautiful people coming towards me, full of vigor, with a lift in the stride, and the light played around them which was emanating from them. They were in white and pale clothes, and one lady had a white dress with material with a blue floral pattern inset. The man slightly in front had fair hair, parted. He already knew exactly how I had come to be there; I was relieved by this. They were amazingly friendly and warm, and I was so pleased to meet them, and still feel really fond of them. I had never seen any of them before. They were warmer, kinder, more gracious and more alive, at one with their purpose, than anyone I have ever met on earth. But I said to God that I had four children, and that this didn't seem the right time - and shortly after an incoming wave, and an outgoing wave met each other and I got my chance to push up. I spent rather a lot of time mourning the lost 'opportunity'.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw five “amazingly spiritually beautiful people” coming towards her, “full of vigor,” with light “emanating from them.” They wore white/pale clothes; one woman had a white dress with blue floral inset; a man slightly in front had fair hair, parted. She had “never seen any of them before.”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After stating to God she had four children and it didn’t seem the right time, an incoming and outgoing wave met and she got the chance to push up.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Nearly drowned while rescuing her deaf daughter in the sea; repeatedly knocked under waves and carried by undercurrent.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prayer to Jesus brought calm; encounter with five unknown spiritually beautiful people; spoke to God about having four children; then returned to physical struggle and surfaced.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel described; experience occurred while being held under waves/undercurrent; then encounter with five beings and communication with God; then resurfaced.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: NDE-like encounter occurred during active drowning struggle in the sea/undercurrent rather than a distinct separation/tunnel sequence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Help me Jesus” ; “I spent rather a lot of time mourning the lost ‘opportunity’.”
